Pope Leo visits Metz to promote peace amid Church abuse crisis

Pope Leo is visiting Metz, eastern France, where he will celebrate Mass on an altar made from German cannon barrels. The visit aims to laud Europe and peace. This trip occurs as the Church confronts a shock of abuse crisis. The coverage also touches on how France handles its strict secularism in preparation for the papal visit.
